holdout_selection.selection_time: before any trajectory data were generated
holdout_selection.rule: maximum resource-capped candidate; adequacy is tested from design variance only

analysis.design_long_run_variance_estimator: batch length times the sample variance of nonoverlapping batch means
analysis.design_variance_upper_rule: chi-square upper bound with lower-tail probability familywise alpha divided by cell count

gaussian_fixed_law.multiple_comparison_rule: Holm over all trajectory-layer and registered law-scale tests

interpretation.flow: A stationary phase label requires adequate design-only power, a stable registered temporal domain, and a direction selected on design and confirmed on holdout.
interpretation.law: No Holm rejection and finite-variance scaling support finite-scale consistency only.
interpretation.universality: Asymptotic universality is not identified by this single-architecture campaign.
interpretation.faces: Only native exact zeros activate the affine source branch.
interpretation.numerical_integrity: The LayerNorm gate-shape check uses full-map Frobenius backward error because quotient-relative energy error is ill-conditioned at the exact face; the symmetric quotient-energy residual remains descriptive.
interpretation.plga: The direct defect is pointwise definitive; five structural residuals are sufficient-condition diagnostics; the sampled operator estimate is a lower bound.
